Kata.Arti_kata_in: dan sungguh akan Kami beri balasan mereka
Kata.Arti_kata_en: and We will surely reward them
and surely they will be questioned
And they ask you to hasten

Kata.Arti_kata_in: dan sungguh akan datang kepada mereka
Kata.Arti_kata_en: But it will surely come to them
surely We will give them a place
